answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the juniper graph. Re-attestations are stored in saffron and signal lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1005 identities would post 3784 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
